findings.claim: MWA 10-K 描述其 Echologics 非侵入式聲學漏水偵測與管況評估為關鍵競爭優勢，並以 Singer Valve 與 i2O 提供智慧水務方案（公司自身技術升級路線，非外部替代品證據）
findings.excerpt: We believe Water Management Solutions’ ability to offer non-invasive leak detection and pipe condition assessment services is a key competitive advantage. With our Singer Valve and i2O products, we provide a range of intelligent water solutions including pressure control valves, advanced pressure management, network analytics, event management and data logging.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子提及競爭對手若更有效運用 AI 改進營運或創造新產品，MWA 有競爭劣勢風險
findings.excerpt: Further, we face risks of competitive disadvantage if our competitors more effectively leverage AI to drive operational efficiencies, create new or enhanced products, services and solutions or otherwise disrupt the marketplace.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：運輸成本高，高運輸成本可能使產品相對競爭者的類似或替代產品較不具競爭力
findings.excerpt: High transportation costs could make our products less competitive compared to similar or alternative products offered by competitors.
